svg.title: Academy — music video style reference (b3-academy)
svg.desc: A print of the song running through a tired projector. Sprockets, optical track, changeover dots, and the lyric burned in as subtitles. Frame is 1600x900; the strip below the frame is apparatus, not part of the film.
svg.text: SECTION VARIATION — THE SAME STYLE AT FIVE POINTS IN THE SONG
Academy leader. The countdown is the count-in
Clean print. Subtitle one line at a time,

g.text: IF I WERE KING FOR JUST A DAY
AND I ALWAYS GOT MY WAY

svg.text: The print degrades. Heavy scratches, gate
Changeover dots. Seventeen of them, top right,

g.text: WALK UNTIL MY BOOTS ARE FADED BLUE

svg.text: The cleanest frame in the film. No dust, no
